field_definitions.still_holding: Current state: wallet has any non-zero DOG balance now. Partitions total_analyzed with sold_everything (still_holding + sold_everything = total_analyzed).
field_definitions.sold_everything: Current state: wallet has zero DOG balance now. Partitions total_analyzed with still_holding.
field_definitions.accumulated: Current state: wallet now holds more DOG than it received in airdrops (bought additional supply).
field_definitions.dumping: Behavioral label, NOT a current state. Sum of by_pattern.paper_hands + panic_seller + early_exit. A wallet labeled "dumping" may still appear in still_holding if it retained a small balance, so dumping > still_holding is expected and not a contradiction.
field_definitions.accumulator_patterns: List of by_pattern keys whose count rolls up into the accumulated total.
